Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint per service | REQ-001 | Infra | open | ### Acceptance — REQ-001 - Profile selection via `DEPLOYMENT_PROFILE` environment variable (`aws` or `onprem`) with no code changes required - Object storage adapter: S3 client for aws profile, S3-compatible client for onprem profile, both implementing identical `ObjectStoragePort` interface - Queue adapter: SQS client for aws profile, approved queue client for onprem profile, both implementing identical `QueuePort` interface - Event adapter: SNS client for aws profile, approved event transport for onprem profile, both implementing identical `EventPort` interface - Secrets adapter: AWS Secrets Manager for aws profile, Vault-compatible client for onprem profile, both implementing identical `SecretsPort` interface - Log sink adapter: CloudWatch for aws profile, centralized log sink for onprem profile, both implementing identical `LogSinkPort` interface - Unit tests verify adapter resolution returns correct implementation for each profile - Integration test with localstack (aws) and minio/redis (onprem) proves both profiles can store and retrieve an object - No business logic may import a concrete adapter directly; all access through port interfaces - Adapter registry is importable by all downstream REQs as `shared.adapters` ### Acceptance — REQ-002 - SQLAlchemy ORM models for: Document, DocumentVersion, IngestJob, ValidationTask, ExportRequest, AuditEntry, EmbeddingRecord, User (reference), Tag - Document entity includes: id (UUID), external_key, title, content_type, file_size, lifecycle_state (enum: Received, Processed, PendingValidation, Validated, Rejected, Archived), classification, extracted_text, metadata_json, created_at, updated_at, created_by, validated_by, validation_timestamp - AuditEntry entity includes: id, document_id, action, actor_id, timestamp, detail_json, previous_state, new_state - EmbeddingRecord entity includes: id, document_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, embedding (pgvector vector type), created_at - All entities have created_at and updated_at with server-default timestamps - Alembic migration baseline creates all tables, indexes, and the pgvector extension in a single `alembic upgrade head` - Migration is idempotent: running upgrade on an already-current database produces no errors - Foreign key relationships enforced: Document→AuditEntry, Document→ValidationTask, Document→EmbeddingRecord, Document→ExportRequest - Business key uniqueness: Document.external_key is unique - Test: fresh PostgreSQL container + `alembic upgrade head` succeeds and all tables exist with correct columns ### Acceptance — REQ-003 - FastAPI dependency `get_current_user` validates OIDC JWT tokens with configurable issuer URL per deployment profile - Token validation checks: signature, expiry, audience, issuer - RBAC decorator/dependency `require_role(roles)` enforces role membership from token claims or mapped IdP groups - Roles defined: `operator`, `validator`, `admin`, `service` - Unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints return 401 with structured error body - Authenticated requests without required role return 403 with structured error body and audit log entry - Service JWT validation for inter-service calls uses shared secret or asymmetric key per profile - Auth module is importable as `shared.auth` by all downstream API REQs - Unit tests: valid token passes, expired token returns 401, wrong role returns 403, missing token returns 401 - Integration test: FastAPI test client with mocked OIDC provider validates full auth flow ### Acceptance — REQ-004 - POST `/api/v1/documents/ingest` accepts multipart file upload with metadata (title, tags, classification hint) - Supported formats validated: pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, jpg, png; unsupported format returns 422 - File size limit enforced (configurable, default 100MB); oversized file returns 413 - File stored in object storage via profile adapter with unique key - IngestJob record created in database with status `pending`, linked to new Document in `Received` state - AuditEntry created for document creation with actor from auth context - Queue message dispatched to OCR worker queue via profile queue adapter containing ingest_job_id and storage_key - Idempotency: re-upload of same external_key returns 409 Conflict - Auth required: `operator` or `admin` role; unauthenticated returns 401; unauthorized returns 403 - Unit tests: happy path upload, format rejection, size rejection, duplicate rejection, auth denial - Integration test: upload file → verify DB record in Received state → verify queue message dispatched ### Acceptance — REQ-005 - Queue consumer listens on OCR worker queue via profile queue adapter - On message receipt: retrieves file from object storage, runs OCR pipeline (Tesseract + PaddleOCR/docTR based on format) - Extracted text stored on Document.extracted_text field - Document classification applied via configurable rules (content type, keyword patterns, optional layout model) - Document.classification field updated with classification result - IngestJob status updated to `completed` on success, `failed` on error with error detail - Document state transitions from `Received` to `Processed` on success - AuditEntry created for state transition with processing metadata - On failure: Document remains in `Received`, IngestJob marked `failed`, error logged with correlation ID - Retry: failed jobs are retried up to 3 times with exponential backoff via queue visibility timeout - Unit tests: successful OCR extraction, classification assignment, failure handling, retry behavior - Integration test: place message on queue → worker processes → verify Document in Processed state with extracted text ### Acceptance — REQ-006 - Document lifecycle state machine enforced at service layer with explicit allowed transitions: - Received → Processed - Processed → PendingValidation - PendingValidation → Validated (only via human validation) - PendingValidation → Rejected (only via human validation) - Validated → Archived - Rejected → PendingValidation (re-submit for validation) - Invalid state transitions return 409 Conflict with current state and attempted transition in error body - GET `/api/v1/documents/{id}` returns document with full metadata, current state, and audit history - GET `/api/v1/documents` returns paginated list with filtering by state, classification, date range, tags - PATCH `/api/v1/documents/{id}/metadata` allows metadata updates (title, tags) without state change - Every state transition creates an AuditEntry with actor, timestamp, previous and new state - Auth required on all endpoints; document list filtered by operator's accessible scope - State machine logic is a reusable service importable by REQ-007 and REQ-010 - Unit tests: every valid transition succeeds, every invalid transition returns 409, metadata update without state change - Integration test: create document → transition through full lifecycle → verify audit trail completeness ### Acceptance — REQ-007 - POST `/api/v1/documents/{id}/submit-for-validation` transitions Processed document to PendingValidation - GET `/api/v1/validation/tasks` returns paginated inbox of PendingValidation documents for current user's role - POST `/api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/approve` transitions to Validated with validator identity and timestamp - POST `/api/v1/validation/tasks/{id}/reject` transitions to Rejected with mandatory rejection reason - Only users with `validator` or `admin` role can approve or reject; others receive 403 - Approval creates ValidationTask record with decision, actor, timestamp, and optional notes - AuditEntry created for every approve/reject action - A document cannot reach Validated state without passing through human validation (no API bypass) - Event published on Validated transition for downstream consumers (embedding worker) - Rejected documents can be re-submitted for validation (Rejected → PendingValidation) - Unit tests: approve flow, reject flow, unauthorized attempt, invalid state transition, re-submission - Integration test: ingest → process → submit → approve → verify Validated state and audit trail ### Acceptance — REQ-008 - GET `/api/v1/archive/search` accepts query string for full-text search across extracted_text of Validated and Archived documents - Full-text search uses PostgreSQL tsvector/tsquery on Document.extracted_text - Metadata filters: classification, content_type, date_range (created_at), tags, lifecycle_state (Validated, Archived only) - Results paginated with cursor or offset pagination, returning document summary (id, title, classification, state, snippet) - Search results respect RBAC: only documents accessible to current user's role/scope are returned - Empty query with filters returns filtered list without full-text ranking - GET `/api/v1/archive/documents/{id}` returns full document detail with extracted text and metadata - Auth required: `operator`, `validator`, or `admin` role - Unit tests: full-text match, metadata filter, combined query, empty results, auth denial - Integration test: create and validate documents → search by text → verify correct results returned ### Acceptance — REQ-009 - POST `/api/v1/export` accepts document_id (single) or document_ids (batch) with format selection (original, pdf, structured_json) - ExportRequest record created in database with status `pending`, linked to requesting user - For single document: generates export artifact and stores in object storage - For batch: generates zip archive of requested documents in selected format - GET `/api/v1/export/{export_id}` returns export status and signed download URL when ready - Signed download URL generated via profile object storage adapter (S3 presigned URL for aws, equivalent for onprem) - Download URL expires after configurable TTL (default 1 hour) - Only Validated or Archived documents can be exported; attempt to export other states returns 409 - Auth required: `operator` or `admin` role; export of documents outside user's scope returns 403 - AuditEntry created for each export request with document IDs and requesting user - Unit tests: single export, batch export, invalid state rejection, auth denial, URL expiry - Integration test: validate document → request export → verify download URL returns correct file ### Acceptance — REQ-010 - Event consumer listens for Validated state transition events - On Validated event: retrieves document extracted_text, chunks text into segments (configurable chunk size and overlap) - Each chunk embedded using bge-m3 model via self-hosted inference endpoint (profile-resolved) - EmbeddingRecord created per chunk with document_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, and pgvector embedding - Only documents in Validated or Archived state are eligible for embedding; pre-validation documents are never embedded - Idempotency: re-processing same document replaces existing embeddings (delete + re-insert) - On failure: error logged with correlation ID, retry via queue retry policy - Embedding worker does not modify document lifecycle state - AuditEntry created for embedding completion with chunk count and model version - Unit tests: chunking logic, embedding storage, idempotency, pre-validation document rejection - Integration test: validate document → event triggers embedding → verify EmbeddingRecords in pgvector ### Acceptance — REQ-011 - POST `/api/v1/qa/ask` accepts natural language question with optional document scope filter - Retrieval queries pgvector for top-k similar chunks using bge-m3 query embedding - Retrieved chunks filtered to only Validated or Archived documents (enforced at query level, not post-filter) - Reranking applied using bge-reranker on retrieved chunks - Top reranked chunks passed as context to self-hosted LLM (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct or Mistral-7B-Instruct per config) - LLM generates answer with source document references (document_id, chunk_text snippet) - Response includes: answer text, source references with document IDs and relevance scores, model used - No prompt logging with unredacted business or personal data (redaction enforced) - Auth required: `operator`, `validator`, or `admin` role - Rate limiting: configurable requests per minute per user - Unit tests: retrieval filtering, reranking order, validated-only enforcement, auth denial, rate limit - Integration test: embed validated documents → ask question → verify answer references only validated documents ### Acceptance — REQ-012 - Next.js 14 app with app router, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI components, Lucide React icons - OIDC login flow: redirect to IdP, handle callback, store tokens, refresh on expiry - Auth state managed via Zustand store with TanStack Query for server state - Protected routes redirect unauthenticated users to login - Dashboard page shows document counts by lifecycle state (Received, Processed, PendingValidation, Validated, Rejected, Archived) - Navigation sidebar with links to: Dashboard, Validation Inbox, Archive Search, Export, Q&A - Navigation items visibility controlled by user role (validator sees inbox, all see archive) - API client module with typed endpoints, auth header injection, error handling - Responsive layout for desktop and tablet viewports - Unit tests: auth flow (login, logout, token refresh), role-based navigation visibility, dashboard count rendering - Integration test: login → dashboard loads with document counts → navigation works ### Acceptance — REQ-013 - Validation inbox page: lists PendingValidation documents with title, classification, submitted date - Document detail view from inbox: shows extracted text, metadata, original file preview (PDF/image) - Approve button triggers POST to validation approve endpoint; reject button opens reason modal then triggers reject - Success/error feedback via toast notifications - After approve/reject, task removed from inbox list - Archive search page: search input for full-text query, filter sidebar for classification, date range, tags - Search results displayed as card list with title, snippet, classification, state - Click result opens document detail view with full extracted text and metadata - Pagination controls for search results - Loading states and empty states for both inbox and search - Unit tests: inbox rendering, approve/reject actions, search input and filter interaction, result rendering - Integration test: navigate to inbox → approve document → verify removed from list; search → verify results displayed ### Acceptance — REQ-014 - Structured JSON logging on all backend services with correlation ID propagation - PII redaction in logs: document content, user email, and personal identifiers are never logged in plain text - OpenTelemetry tracing configured on FastAPI and worker services with span propagation across queue messages - Trace context propagated through queue message headers for end-to-end tracing - Prometheus-compatible `/metrics` endpoint on each backend service exposing: request count, latency histogram, error rate, queue depth - Log sink adapter routes logs to CloudWatch (aws profile) or centralized log sink (onprem profile) - Health check endpoint `GET /health` on each service returning service status and dependency connectivity - Unit tests: log output format validation, PII redaction verification, metrics endpoint response - Integration test: send request → verify trace spans created → verify metrics incremented → verify logs contain correlation ID ## Dependency Graph (textual) ``` REQ-001 (no dependencies) REQ-002 -> REQ-001 REQ-003 -> REQ-001 REQ-014 -> REQ-001 REQ-004 -> REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003 REQ-005 -> REQ-002, REQ-004 REQ-006 -> REQ-002, REQ-003 REQ-007 -> REQ-003, REQ-005, REQ-006 REQ-008 -> REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-006 REQ-009 -> REQ-001, REQ-003, REQ-006 REQ-010 -> REQ-002, REQ-006, REQ-007 REQ-011 -> REQ-003, REQ-008, REQ-010 REQ-012 -> REQ-003 REQ-013 -> REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-012 ``` ## Iteration Strategy ### Batch 1 — Foundation (S) - **REQ-001** (Infra — profile adapters) - **Unlocks:** All downstream REQs can resolve infrastructure adapters - **Confidence:** High ### Batch 2 — Data + Auth Backbone (S) - **REQ-002** (Data — canonical entities and migrations) - **REQ-003** (App — OIDC auth and RBAC) - **REQ-014** (Infra — observability baseline) - **Unlocks:** All API and worker REQs can persist data, enforce auth, and emit traces - **Confidence:** High ### Batch 3 — Ingest-to-Process Slice (M) - **REQ-004** (App — document ingest) - **REQ-006** (App — lifecycle state machine and metadata API) - **Unlocks:** Documents can be uploaded, stored, and queried; state machine available for validation and archive - **Journey:** Operator uploads document → document appears in Received state → metadata queryable - **Confidence:** High ### Batch 4 — OCR + Validation Slice (M) - **REQ-005** (App — OCR/IDP worker) - **REQ-007** (App — human validation workflow) - **Unlocks:** Full ingest-to-validated journey; documents can reach Validated state - **Journey:** Upload → OCR processing → submit for validation → human approves → Validated - **Confidence:** Medium-High (OCR pipeline complexity) ### Batch 5 — Archive + Export (M) - **REQ-008** (App — archive search) - **REQ-009** (App — export service) - **Unlocks:** Validated documents searchable and exportable - **Journey:** Search validated documents → view details → export as PDF - **Confidence:** High ### Batch 6 — AI/RAG Slice (L) - **REQ-010** (App — embedding worker) - **REQ-011** (App — RAG Q&A API) - **Unlocks:** Validated-only Q&A over document corpus - **Journey:** Validated document → auto-embedded → operator asks question → gets answer with sources - **Confidence:** Medium (GPU inference dependency, model serving setup) ### Batch 7 — Frontend (M) - **REQ-012** (App — operator dashboard) - **REQ-013** (App — validation inbox + archive search UI) - **Unlocks:** Full operator-facing UI for all backend capabilities - **Journey:** Login → dashboard → validate documents → search archive → ask questions - **Confidence:** High **Estimation band:** ±1 batch for Batch 6 (AI/RAG may require infrastructure stabilization) ## Test Strategy ### Per-REQ Test Requirements All REQs must include: - **Happy path:** At least one test proving the primary success scenario - **Auth denial:** At least one test proving unauthenticated (401) and unauthorized (403) behavior where auth applies - **Business error:** At least one test proving invalid input, invalid state, or business rule violation is handled correctly - **Persistence assertion:** At least one test verifying database state after mutation (record exists, fields correct, audit entry created) - **No-side-effect assertion:** At least one test verifying read-only operations do not mutate state - **Profile parity:** For REQ-001 and REQ-014, tests must run against both aws and onprem profile configurations - **Idempotency:** For REQ-004 (duplicate upload), REQ-005 (retry), REQ-010 (re-embedding), tests must verify idempotent behavior - **Contract stability:** REQs that produce shared contracts (REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-006) must include tests that downstream REQs can import and assert against ### Per-Batch Integration Tests - **Batch 2:** Auth middleware integration with test OIDC provider; migration on clean database - **Batch 3:** Upload → DB record → queue message end-to-end - **Batch 4:** Upload → OCR → validation → Validated state end-to-end - **Batch 5:** Search returns only validated documents; export generates downloadable URL - **Batch 6:** Embedding created on validation → Q&A returns sourced answer - **Batch 7:** Frontend login → dashboard data loads → validation action succeeds ### Test Tooling - **Python backend:** pytest, pytest-asyncio, httpx (TestClient), factory_boy for fixtures - **Frontend:** Vitest, React Testing Library, MSW for API mocking - **Database:** testcontainers-python with PostgreSQL + pgvector - **Queue/Storage:** localstack for aws profile, minio + redis for onprem profile ## KIT Readiness (per REQ) ### REQ-001 — Runtime Profile Adapter Layer - **Root:** `runs/kit/REQ-001/src/backend/shared/adapters/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-001/test/backend/shared/adapters/` - **Canonical family:** `shared.adapters` - **Shared modules reused:** None (this is the foundation) - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `ports.py`, `object_storage.py`, `queue.py`, `eventing.py`, `secrets.py`, `log_sink.py`, `registry.py` - **Forbidden paths:** No business logic in adapter layer - **Primary outcome:** All infrastructure access goes through port interfaces; profile switch is env-var driven - **Stable contracts for downstream:** `ObjectStoragePort`, `QueuePort`, `EventPort`, `SecretsPort`, `LogSinkPort`, `get_adapter(profile, port_type)` registry function - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `ports.py` (abstract interfaces), `object_storage.py` (S3 + S3-compatible), `queue.py` (SQS + approved queue), `eventing.py` (SNS + approved transport), `secrets.py` (SecretsManager + Vault), `log_sink.py` (CloudWatch + centralized), `registry.py` (profile-aware resolution), `conftest.py` (profile fixtures) - **Minimum tests:** adapter resolution per profile, object store/retrieve per profile, queue send/receive per profile ### REQ-002 — Canonical Data Contract Backbone - **Root:** `runs/kit/REQ-002/src/backend/shared/models/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-002/test/backend/shared/models/` - **Canonical family:** `shared.models` - **Shared modules reused:** `shared.adapters` (database connection via profile) - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `entities.py`, `enums.py`, `migrations/` - **Forbidden paths:** No API routes, no business logic beyond model definitions - **Primary outcome:** All canonical entities defined, Alembic baseline migration runnable - **Stable contracts for downstream:** All entity classes, `LifecycleState` enum, relationship definitions, `AuditEntry` model - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `entities.py`, `enums.py`, `base.py` (declarative base), `migrations/env.py`, `migrations/versions/001_baseline.py`, `alembic.ini` - **Minimum tests:** migration on clean DB, all tables exist, column types correct, foreign keys enforced ### REQ-003 — OIDC Auth and RBAC - **Root:** `runs/kit/REQ-003/src/backend/shared/auth/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-003/test/backend/shared/auth/` - **Canonical family:** `shared.auth` - **Shared modules reused:** `shared.adapters` (secrets for signing keys) - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `oidc.py`, `rbac.py`, `dependencies.py`, `models.py` - **Forbidden paths:** No direct database access; auth module is stateless - **Primary outcome:** `get_current_user` and `require_role` FastAPI dependencies available for all API REQs - **Stable contracts for downstream:** `get_current_user`, `require_role(roles)`, `CurrentUser` model, `ServiceTokenValidator` - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `oidc.py` (token validation), `rbac.py` (role enforcement), `dependencies.py` (FastAPI deps), `models.py` (CurrentUser, TokenClaims) - **Minimum tests:** valid token, expired token (401), wrong role (403), missing token (401), service JWT validation ### REQ-004 — Document Ingest API - **Root:** `runs/kit/REQ-004/src/backend/api/ingest/` - **Test root:** `runs/kit/REQ-004/test/backend/api/ingest/` - **API docs:** `runs/kit/REQ-004/test/api/ingest.http` - **Canonical family:** `api.ingest` - **Shared modules reused:** `shared.adapters` (object storage, queue), `shared.models` (Document, IngestJob, AuditEntry), `shared.auth` (get_current_user, require_role) - **New modules allowed:** Yes — `router.py`, `service.py`, `schemas.py` - **Forbidden paths:** No direct adapter instantiation; use registry - **Primary outcome:** Documents can be uploaded, stored, and queued for OCR - **Stable contracts for downstream:** IngestJob with `pending` status, Document in `Received` state, queue message schema - **KIT-functional:** yes - **Key files:** `router.py`, `service.py`, `schemas.py` (request/response models) - **Minimum tests:** happy upload, format rejection (422), size rejection (413), duplicate (409), auth denial (401/403), queue dispatch verification ### REQ-005 — OCR/IDP
